name: table-monorepo
description: Tablé Monorepo Architecture & Unified DX Integration

scripts.docker:mobile: docker compose --profile mobile up -d --build mobile && npm run docker:mobile:url
scripts.docker:mobile:url:
echo 'Waiting for the Expo tunnel...'; for i in $(seq 45); do url=$(docker compose logs mobile 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[a-z0-9-]+\.exp\.direct' | tail -1); [ -n "$url" ] && break; sleep 2; done; if [ -n "$url" ]; then printf '
  Expo web/browser : https://%s
  Expo Go on phone : exp://%s

' "$url" "$url"; else echo 'No tunnel URL after 90s. Check `npm run docker:mobile:logs` — in LAN mode (EXPO_START_ARGS) the logs carry an exp://<lan-ip> URL instead.'; fi
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose --profile '*' down -v && docker compose up -d --build
scripts.dev:mobile: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm exec -w frontend/mobile-app -- expo start --tunnel"
